items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Oh yeah, I worked when Harry James played with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know. That's a long time. Yeah. Oh, did you work with Ben Pollock on regular or not?
Oh yeah, I worked when Harry James played with him. Mm-hmm.

We worked on the West Coast, you know, all over the West Coast. I tell you, we played Reno when Reno was nothing before Las Vegas, you know. And Reno was nothing. It was a small town, see? Mm-hmm. And, uh, but we went all over, Eugene, Oregon, uh, Seattle. What's, uh, Salt Lake City? Yeah. We went there and, uh, two trumpet players got lost. And would you believe I had to play trumpet parts?
